johnisanerd-claude-skill-youtube-transcr.description: Get YouTube transcripts as structured JSON with a hosted YouTube transcript API (the Apify Actor johnvc/YoutubeTranscripts). Pass one video URL or a batch array and get back non_timestamped text, timestamped snippets, language metadata, and optional SRT, VTT, and plain text formats, plus video title, channel, and view count. Works with standard videos and Shorts, handles language preference and translation, and runs from cloud IPs without IpBlocked errors.
